narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly alike. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, the measure of how much pay is claimed before you ever see it. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. The money was furthest apart in month {widest_gap_month}, the very last, where the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's days, by the game's own reckoning, came out {life_gap}.
